value.name: Marcus clarifies lunch rule
value.description: Marcus tells the other person that lunch with her is allowed under the representation rule and that the rule does not govern the rest of life.
evidence: "I am not telling you what to do. I am telling you what the rule says and what it does not say. The other part is your business."
"You should have lunch with her. You are allowed. The rule exists for the duration of the representation. The rule does not exist for the rest of your life."

value.name: Lunch is acknowledged and paid for
value.description: The exchange ends with thanks and Marcus insisting on payment, after which she pays for lunch.
evidence: "Do not thank me. Pay for lunch."

value.name: Appraisal arrives Wednesday morning
value.description: On Wednesday morning, the appraisal comes in with a valuation between the buyers' offer and any reasonable seller's refusal point.
evidence: On Wednesday morning the appraisal arrived.
The number was, as Pelletier had said it would be, both higher than the buyers had offered and lower than any sane seller would refuse

value.name: Asha emails appraisal to clients
value.description: Asha sends the appraisal to all three clients by email and receives prompt, restrained acknowledgments.
evidence: Asha sent it to all three clients by email at nine-fifteen
by ten she had received three acknowledgments, all of which were polite and brief and none of which contained any expression of surprise or distress

value.name: Asha feels professional triumph
value.description: Asha privately judges the clients' calm responses to be the closest thing to a triumph her profession allows.
evidence: which was, she thought, the closest thing to a triumph her profession permitted itself

value.name: Asha drafts multiple deal structures
value.description: Asha spends the rest of the week drafting three possible structures and circulates them without endorsing any one option.
evidence: The rest of the week passed in drafting.
She drafted three possible structures and circulated all three with a covering memo that did not recommend among them.

value.name: Asha drafts Daniel-Rosa occupancy agreement
value.description: At Daniel's request, Asha prepares a side agreement governing Rosa's life occupancy of the second-floor bedroom and bathroom for review by Rosa's independent counsel.
evidence: She drafted, separately and at Daniel's specific request, a side agreement between Daniel and Rosa concerning the life occupancy of the second-floor bedroom and bathroom, to be reviewed by independent counsel for Rosa before execution

value.name: Asha connects Marcus with Rosa's lawyer
value.description: Asha arranges for Marcus to contact a lawyer at another firm whom Rosa will meet on Friday afternoon.
evidence: she put Marcus in touch with a lawyer at another firm whom Rosa would meet on Friday afternoon at four

value.name: Asha drafts partition-in-use agreement
value.description: Asha prepares a partition-in-use agreement between Daniel and Lucia.
evidence: She drafted a partition-in-use agreement between Daniel and Lucia.
